latest_nl_proof: Fix integers A,B with A>=B>=0. In the d-parameter construction under discussion, setting d=0 gives the boundary case where the defining product for Q_{A,B,d}(q) has no factors. Hence Q_{A,B,0}(q) is the empty product, so Q_{A,B,0}(q)=1. Likewise, the weighted polynomial ring at parameter d has one variable for each index 1,...,d; when d=0 there are no variables, so the ring is just the coefficient field Q. Thus S=Q. Now consider the empty sequence in S. There are no elements to check, so the homogeneity condition is vacuous. The regularity condition is also vacuous; and if one includes the usual requirement that the final quotient be nonzero, that is satisfied as well because S=Q is nonzero. Therefore the empty sequence is a homogeneous regular sequence in S. The ideal generated by the empty sequence is the zero ideal, so the quotient by that sequence is S/(0)=S itself. Finally, with the induced grading on the zero-variable weighted polynomial ring S=Q, we have S_0=Q and S_m=0 for every m>0. Therefore the graded Hilbert series is H_S(t)=sum_{m>=0} dim_Q(S_m) t^m = 1. This proves all parts of the statement.
